title: A simple strategy that performs remarkably consistently.
author: Ok-Basil2753
selftext:
Lost a Lamborghini last week.

Won back a Lamborghini this week.

My goal has never been a 100% win rate. The objective has always been simple: control losses, protect capital, and drive growth through profitable trades.

My trading strategy is highly systematic, covering ascending triangle breakouts confirmed by volume, double top and double bottom patterns, flag (and pennant) patterns, and volatility contraction patterns confirmed by ATR (Average True Range). Additionally, the strategy utilizes 5-day, 13-day, 34-day, and 55-day moving averages for multi stage trend verification, integrating analysis across short, medium, and long term timeframes.

I share information for free in a group every day, including stock selection logic, risk warnings, trading opportunities, and entry points.

If you’re interested in learning, exchanging ideas, or gaining a fresh perspective on the market I’m not promising overnight riches, just sharing my experience feel free to leave a comment or send me a private message. I look forward to discussing these topics and growing together.

comments.author: themajordutch
comments.body:
consistency/kənˈsistn(t)sē/

Consistency means the quality of staying uniform, steady, or reliable over time. It can refer to behaviors remaining the same, arguments making logical sense, or the physical thickness and texture of a substance.

replies.author: Ok-Basil2753
replies.body: This applies to investing too. A single great decision can be luck, but consistently making reasonable decisions over time is what really matters.
